name: Aqara Smart Lock U300 (US)

radios.note: Aqara's FAQ says the U300 supports Matter over Thread and Bluetooth 5.0; CSA lists Thread and Bluetooth.

matter.note: CSA lists the Smart Lock U300 from Lumi United (Aqara): Matter 1.2, certified 2024-06-04, product ID 0x2801, Matter over Thread. The listing does not name a region.

apple_home.note: Matter over Thread. Needs an Apple home hub with Thread (HomePod mini, HomePod 2nd gen or Apple TV 4K).

google_home.note: Needs a Thread border router that supports Matter.

alexa.note: Needs a Thread border router that supports Matter.

smartthings.note: Needs a Thread border router that supports Matter.

home_assistant.note: No Aqara or Home Assistant docs page we found names this lock. The Matter integration may work, unconfirmed.

hubRequired.note: Not settled by an official source we could see. Retailer spec tables say a hub is required; press coverage says the Aqara app works without one and other Matter platforms need a Thread border router.

localControl.note: No Aqara source states local-only control.

lockFit.note: Aqara's first lever lock; the FAQ says it replaces common single-latch handle or knob locks.

keypad.note: Keypad on the outer panel, which Aqara rates IPX4.

power.note: Retailers and reviews list four AA batteries (up to 10 months) plus a USB-C emergency port; we found no official Aqara page stating it.

summary: Aqara's first lever lock, the Smart Lock U300 swaps in for a single-latch handle or knob and has a keypad on the outer panel. Matter over Thread connects it to Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa and SmartThings through a Thread border router. Aqara doesn't say clearly whether its own hub is also required.
caveats: Matter needs a Thread border router; for Apple that means a HomePod mini, HomePod 2nd gen or Apple TV 4K.
Aqara's FAQ says the outer panel is IPX4 and does not recommend it for exposed outdoor spots.
Whether an Aqara hub is required is not confirmed by an official source.
